sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob Sidecar Gossip Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the P2P gossip mechanism for distributing blob sidecars across the network via subnet topics

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Created by Proposer
nodes.description: Block proposer has created BlobSidecar containing blob data, KZG commitment, proof, signed header, and Merkle inclusion proof

nodes.label: Compute Blob Sidecar Subnet
nodes.description: Determine target subnet via compute_subnet_for_blob_sidecar() based on blob index

nodes.label: Publish Blob Sidecar to Subnet Topic
nodes.description: Broadcast blob sidecar to blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} gossip topic

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Received by Peer
nodes.description: A peer has received a blob sidecar message on a subnet topic

nodes.label: Validate Blob Sidecar
nodes.description: Validate: index < MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK, correct subnet mapping, valid proposer signature, valid inclusion proof, valid KZG proof

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Accepted
nodes.description: Blob sidecar passed all validation checks and accepted into local store

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Rejected
nodes.description: Blob sidecar failed validation, rejected and not propagated

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Remote peer node sending blob sidecars via P2P gossip

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Blob Sidecar Request/Response Protocols
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response protocols for retrieving blob sidecars by range and by root

nodes.label: Blob Data Needed for Slot Range
nodes.description: Node needs blob sidecars for a range of slots or specific block roots

nodes.label: Request BlobSidecarsByRange
nodes.description: Send BlobSidecarsByRange v1 request specifying start_slot and count, limited to MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS (768)

nodes.label: Request BlobSidecarsByRoot
nodes.description: Send BlobSidecarsByRoot v1 request with specific BlobIdentifiers (block_root, index pairs)

nodes.label: Check Blob Retention Window
nodes.description: Verify requested slots are within MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS (~18 days) retention period

nodes.label: Blob Sidecars Served to Requester
nodes.description: Requested blob sidecars returned to the requesting peer

nodes.label: Resource Unavailable Error
nodes.description: Peer cannot serve requested blobs (outside retention window), returns error code 3

external_entities.name: Requesting Peer
external_entities.description: Peer node requesting blob sidecars for syncing or recovery

sub_graphs.title: Deneb: Beacon Block Gossip Validation with Blob Commitments
sub_graphs.description: Models the updated beacon block validation rules including blob KZG commitment limits

nodes.label: Beacon Block Received via Gossip
nodes.description: A Deneb-format signed beacon block received on the beacon_block gossip topic

nodes.label: Validate Attestation Propagation Window
nodes.description: Per EIP-7045, accept attestations from current or previous epoch (extended from single-epoch window)

nodes.label: Validate Block Request Limits
nodes.description: Enforce MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB (128) limit on BeaconBlocksByRange/Root requests

nodes.label: Block Passed Deneb Validation
nodes.description: Block meets all Deneb-specific validation criteria

nodes.label: Block Failed Deneb Validation
nodes.description: Block violates Deneb validation rules, rejected

external_entities.name: Gossip Network Peer
external_entities.description: Peer propagating beacon blocks via gossip protocol

ambiguities.text: The specification states peers 'may face disconnection or penalties' for not serving blobs within the retention window but does not specify exact penalty conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume peer scoring is implementation-defined, with ResourceUnavailable errors contributing to negative peer scores that may trigger disconnection at implementer-defined thresholds.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail the ordering guarantees for blob sidecars returned in a BlobSidecarsByRange response.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob sidecars are returned in ascending order by (slot, index) consistent with other range-based request protocols.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes are assumed to have sufficient storage and bandwidth to maintain blob sidecars for the full MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS retention period (~18 days).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes pruning blobs early would be unable to serve peers, potentially degrading network availability for syncing nodes.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge valid KZG proofs for blob sidecars without access to the correct blob data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged blob sidecars could pass validation and pollute the network with invalid blob data.

implicit_assumptions.description: The 6 blob sidecar subnets provide sufficient distribution and redundancy for reliable blob propagation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Insufficient subnet diversity could allow targeted eclipse attacks on specific blob data, causing data availability failures.
